title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - October 06, 2025

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 3:04 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Upper Canada Park Public Art Commission, DSD-2025-358
notes: The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2025-358, dated September 15, 2025, recommending the Mayor and Clerk implement an agreement with Javid Jah and his organization JAH Cube for the commissioning and creation of a new public artwork, 'The Seams' to be installed at Upper Canada Park.

attachments.name: Upper Canada Park public art commission - DSD-2025-358.pdf

items.title: Racialized and Indigenous Supports for Equity (RISE) Fund, 3 Year Update, COR-2025-386
notes:
The Committee considered Corporate Services Department report COR-2025-386, dated September 23, 2025, recommending revisions to the Racialized and Indigenous Supports for Equity (RISE) Grant funding framework to align with the evolving needs of equity-denied communities in the City of Kitchener.

Councillor A. Owodunni entered the meeting at this time.

Y. Torres provided a presentation on this matter and responded to questions from the Committee. V. Raab and R. Morris were also in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee.

Mayor B. Vrbanovic entered the meeting at this time.

items.title: 2025-2026 Gas Supply and Delivery Rates, INS-2025-399
notes:
The Committee considered Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2025-399, dated September 17, 2025 outlining proposed changes to the Kitchener Utilities' natural gas variable and fixed delivery rates.

G. St. Louis provided a presentation on this matter and responded to questions from the Committee. D. McGoldrick and K. Abu-Eseifan were also in attendance and responded to questions from the Committee.

motions.item_title: Upper Canada Park Public Art Commission, DSD-2025-358
motions.text: it was resolved: "That the commission and creation of a new public artwork, “The Seams,” by Javid Jah and his organization JAH Cube, to be installed at Upper Canada Park as part of the final phase of its current facility improvements, be approved; and further, That the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to implement an agreement, satisfactory to the City Solicitor, with the artist team, outlining the obligations of the commission, as outlined in Development Services Department report DSD-2025-358."

motions.item_title: Racialized and Indigenous Supports for Equity (RISE) Fund, 3 Year Update, COR-2025-386
motions.text: it was resolved: "That Council endorse the revisions to the Racialized and Indigenous Supports for Equity (RISE) Grant funding framework to align with the evolving needs of equity-denied communities in the City of Kitchener, as outlined in Corporate Services Department report COR-2025-038."

motions.item_title: 2025-2026 Gas Supply and Delivery Rates, INS-2025-399
motions.text: it was resolved: "That Kitchener Utilities’ natural gas variable and fixed delivery rates be approved as proposed in Infrastructure Services Department report INS-2025-399 - Attachment 'A', for all Kitchener delivery customers effective January 1, 2026."
